subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to share the details of our upcoming trip to Paris. We have booked flights for Thursday, May 20th, departing at 9:00 AM. Our hotel reservation is at Hotel Eiffel, and we have tours planned for the Louvre and Eiffel Tower. Please review the itinerary attached and let me know if you have any questions or need further information. Looking forward to our trip! Best regards, [Your Name]
